subject: POC trial planning - FinTechX workload intake
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@fintechx.com>, Carlos Medina <c.medina@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC trial planning - FinTechX workload intake

Thanks for the productive sync earlier today - appreciate you walking through the integration and the main success goals. Per our conversation, I wanted to summarize the proposed POC scope and capture the workload details we'll need from your side to size the trial and propose nodes/config.

High-level POC / success criteria (confirmed on call):
- Functional parity for the two main flows: fraud-alert summarization + enrichment (primary) and customer support canned-response generation (secondary)
- Latency: 95th <= 150ms for the summarization flow under target load
- Cost target: <$0.02 per 1k tokens served during the trial (baseline for executive approval)
- Quality checks: top-10 accuracy on enrichment matches and no hallucinations in >= 98% of cases across a 500-sample eval set

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- 4-week trial (2 weeks integration + 2 weeks steady-state evaluation)
- Week 0: credentialing + sample payload exchange
- Week 1: small-scale smoke & tuning (SE-led)
- Weeks 2-3: performance testing and quality evals
- Week 4: wrap & exec review

Immediate ask (workload intake): please confirm the following workload profile so we can size a Dedicated trial config and recommend batching/quantization settings:
- Steady-state RPS (avg requests/sec):
- Peak RPS and typical burst duration:
- Typical tokens/request (avg) and max tokens/request:
- Expected concurrency / active sessions during peaks:
- Typical request distributions: % short (<=64 tokens), % medium (65-512), % long (>512)
- Any daily/hourly traffic patterns (timezone & business hours) and known traffic spikes (e.g., payroll windows, marketing blasts)

I attached the initial POC scope doc (poc_scope_fintechx_v1.pdf) that maps our proposed deliverables and success criteria. Once you confirm the workload numbers below we'll propose a trial topology and a quick cost/latency estimate.

Next steps:
1) You reply to this thread with the workload numbers and any sample payloads/logs you can share (sample_api_logs.txt is helpful).
2) SE (Marissa) will schedule a 60-min kickoff for detailed integration and test plan.
3) We'll deliver an initial sizing recommendation within 48 business hours after we get the workload profile.

Thanks - talk soon.

--
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@fintechx.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC trial planning - FinTechX workload intake

Thanks Ben - great recap. Below are the workload numbers we discussed and I've attached a redacted sample of API logs. Let us know if you need additional fields.

Workload profile (initial):
- Steady-state RPS (avg requests/sec): ~2 req/s across our primary region (US-West)
- Peak RPS and typical burst duration: peaks up to 30 req/s for ~10-20s during onboarding waves; occasional larger bursts up to 120 req/s for <5s during batch backfills
- Typical tokens/request (avg) and max tokens/request: avg ~350 tokens, median ~220, max observed ~2000 tokens (long enrichment traces)
- Expected concurrency / active sessions during peaks: 5-10 concurrently active sessions for the real-time flow; up to ~25 concurrent workers for async batch enrichment jobs
- Typical request distributions: short <=64: 20%; medium 65-512: 70%; long >512: 10%
- Traffic patterns: primary business hours 08:00-18:00 PT; onboarding/test windows typically early mornings; we have weekly marketing push on Tue mornings that increases load for ~30-60m

POC logistics:
- Desired trial length: 4 weeks (matches your outline)
- Success criteria (internal): latency 95th <= 150ms for real-time flow; no more than 1% error rate; quality thresholds as you listed (we'll share the 500-sample eval set once we're ready)

Attached: sample_api_logs.txt (redacted)

We're OK with Redwood provisioning a small Dedicated pool for the trial. Please send the proposed sizing and the SE checklist for getting keys/metrics in place. Scheduling: Marissa - can we aim for a kickoff on Monday 15 Feb in the morning PT?

Thanks,
Alice Jensen
Engineering Manager, Integrations | FinTechX
alice.jensen@fintechx.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Feb 2027 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC trial planning - FinTechX workload intake

Hi Alice / Ben - thanks for the quick turnaround and the logs. I reviewed the sample and sketched a recommended test matrix and immediate SE tasks below.

Recommended trial topology (initial):
- 2 x g4-like instances (Dedicated) with 8 GPU cores equivalent serving agents, continuous batching enabled, KV cache warmed for enrichment keys
- Autoscale trigger: CPU/GPU utilization >= 75% for 60s, burst policy to add up to 4x capacity for <60s windows (to handle the occasional 120 req/s spikes)
- Model config: optimized open model variant (quantized) for lower cost on response-generation flows; we'll run a calibration step to confirm latency with your median 220-token payloads

Suggested test matrix (week-by-week):
- Week 0 (credentialing): share sandbox credentials + sample payloads (Ben to own delivery)
- Week 1 (smoke + calibration): 1k synthetic requests at median token sizes, measure 95th latency, tune batching and KV cache TTLs (Marissa owns)
- Week 2 (stress + burst tests): run steady-state at 2 RPS for 1-hour window, then run burst scripts (30, 120 req/s) and measure p95/p99 latency and error rates
- Week 3 (quality eval): run 500-sample eval set and compare against baseline thresholds; collect human review on enrichment accuracy (customer provides labels)
- Week 4 (wrap & review): share final report + recommended production config

SE checklist (what I need from you before kickoff):
- Sample payloads and 500-sample eval set (redacted of PII)
- Sandbox API keys (we'll provide an endpoint and a read-only usage key)
- Confirmation on whether batch enrichment jobs can be replayed into the sandbox (Carlos? in CC)

Links: POC playbook + test harness (https://redwood.sharepoint.com/drive/poc-playbook)

I can run the week-1 calibration on Monday morning PT; Ben, please confirm the kickoff slot and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks - looking forward to getting started.

--
